paite: Huan kum thum sung Siriate leh Israelte kidou lou in a-om uhi.
heading: Zawlnei Mikaiah In Ahab Avauhilh / (2 Kro 18.2-27)
english: They continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.

paite: Akum thum kum in hichi ahong hi a, Israel kumpipa kiang ah Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat ahohsuk hi.
english: In the third year, Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.

paite: Israel kumpipa'n asikhate kiang ah, "Ramoth-gilead khua ei a ahi chih thei napi a, bangchidan a Siria kumpipa khut a pan sutkhe lou a mawk om i hi ua oi?" achi hi.
english: The king of Israel said to his servants, “You know that Ramoth Gilead is ours, and we do nothing, and don’t take it out of the hand of the king of Syria?”

paite: Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ramoth-gilead ah galdou ding in kei toh na hong kuan diam?" achi hi. Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Kei leh nang, ka mite leh na mite pum khat i hi ua, ka sakol leh na sakol pum khat ahi ve ua le," achi hi.
english: He said to Jehoshaphat, “Will you go with me to battle to Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”

paite: Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Tuni in TOUPA thu dong in, chi in ka hon ngen," achi hi.
english: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for Yahweh’s word.”

paite: Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n zawlnei mi zali asamkhawm a, akiang uah, "Ramoth-gilead khua dou ding in ka kuantou diam, kuantou lou ding?" achi hi. Amau, "Kuan in, Toupa'n kumpipa khut ah ahon pe ding,” achi uh.
english: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said to them, “Should I go against Ramoth Gilead to battle, or should I refrain?” They said, “Go up; for the Lord will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

paite: Himahleh Jehoshaphat in, "Hiai ah TOUPA zawlnei dang kuahiam bek i dot ding om lou hia?" achi hi.
english: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of Yahweh, that we may inquire of him?”

paite: Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "TOUPA hon dotsak ding mi khat Imlah tapa Mikaiah om lai veh aw. Himahleh amah ka hua hi; ka tungtang thu ahoih lou lam lou ngal agen ngei kei," achi hi. Jehoshaphat in, "Kumpipa'n hichibang in chi kei hen," achi hi.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of Yahweh, Micaiah the son of Imlah; but I hate him, for he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”

paite: Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n heutu khat asam a, "Kintak in Imlah tapa Mikaiah va pi mah dih," achi hi.
english: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Quickly get Micaiah the son of Imlah.”

paite: Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat bel Samaria kongpi lutna gei phaizang ah akumpipa uh puan a kithuam in alaltutphah tuaktuak uah atu ua, zawlnei tengteng in ama uah thu agen uhi.
english: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting each on his throne, arrayed in their robes, in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.

paite: Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in sik kiite abawlsak a, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hiaite in Siriate mangthang sipsip khop in na hihse ding chi in," achi hi.
english: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘With these you will push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”

paite: Huchi mah bang in zawlnei tengteng in, "Ramoth-gilead ah va hohtou inla, va lohching in, TOUPA'N kumpipa khut ah ahon pe ding," chi in agen uhi.
english: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead and prosper; for Yahweh will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

paite: Mikaiah sam dia sawl a ompa'n akiang ah, "Ngai dih, zawlneite'n thukhat sat in ahoih lam in kumpipa kiang ah thu agen chiat uh. Agen khitsa bang un gen sam inla, ahoih lam in va gen in," chi in angen hi.
english: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “See now, the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Please let your word be like the word of one of them, and speak good.”

paite: Mikaiah in, "TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi, TOUPA'N ka kiang ah agen mah ka va gen ding," achi hi.
english: Micaiah said, “As Yahweh lives, what Yahweh says to me, that I will speak.”

paite: Kumpipa kiang atuntouh in, kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Mikaiah, Ramoth-gilead khua dou ding in ka kuantou diam, kuantou lou ding?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Kuantou inla, va lohching in; TOUPA'N kumpipa khut ah ahon pe ding," achi hi.
english: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall we forbear?” He answered him, “Go up and prosper; and Yahweh will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang ah, “Thutak kia lou ngal ka kiang a TOUPA min agen lou dia bangzah vei ahia ka hon kichiamsak ding?" achi hi.
english: The king said to him, “How many times do I have to adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in Yahweh’s name?”

paite: Ama'n, "Israel tengteng ching ding nei lou belam bang in tang a dalhzak in ka mu hi. TOUPA'N, hiaite'n heutu aneita kei ua, michih ama inn chiat ah lungmuangtak in pai hen achi," achi hi.
english: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. Yahweh said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”

paite: Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ka tungtang thu ahoih lou lam kia lou ngal, ahoih lam himhim agen kei ding chih ka hon hilh ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”

paite: Ama'n, "Huaiziak in TOUPA thu ngaikhe dih, TOUPA alaltutphah tung a tu, van a mipi tengteng ataklam leh veilam a dinghte toh ka mu hi.
english: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear Yahweh’s word. I saw Yahweh sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.

paite: TOUPA'N, Ramoth-gilead a hohtou a, gal a si dia kua'n Ahab kunzou ding ahia? achi hi. Khat in hichibang in, midang in huchibang in," achi uh.
english: Yahweh said, ‘Who will entice Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One said one thing, and another said another.

paite: Huchi in kha khat ahong pawt a, TOUPA ma ah adingh a, "Ke'n ka kunzou ding," achi hi.
english: A spirit came out and stood before Yahweh, and said, ‘I will entice him.’

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Bang in eita? achi hi. Ama'n ka va hoh dia, azawlnei teng muk ah kha zuauthei ka va suak ding, achi hi. Ama'n va kun mah inla, na lohching lai ding. Va kuan inla, huchibang in va hih ve leh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to him, ‘How?’ He said, ‘I will go out and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ He said, ‘You will entice him, and will also prevail. Go out and do so.’

paite: "Huaiziak in tu in ngai in, TOUPA'N hiai na zawlnei teng muk ah kha zuauthei akoih a, na tungtang thu ahoih lou lam TOUPA'N agen khinta," achi hi.
english: Now therefore, behold, Yahweh has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these your prophets; and Yahweh has spoken evil concerning you.”

paite: Huchi in Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in ahon naih a, Mikaiah biang ahong beng a, "TOUPA Kha in na kiang a thu gen ding in kei a pan koilam ah ahia apai?" achi hi.
english: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did Yahweh’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”

paite: Mikaiah in, "Ngai in, dantan sunggil a kibu dia na lut ni in na thei ding," achi hi.
english: Micaiah said, “Behold, you will see on that day when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”

paite: Israel kumpipa'n, "Mikaiah pi unla, khopi ukpipa Ammon leh kumpi tapa Joash kiang ah paipih nawn un," achi hi.
english: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son.

paite: Kumpipa'n hichi in achi, "Hiai mi suangkul ah khum unla, galmuang a ka hong pai nawn masiah gimthuakna an leh gimthuakna tui na pia un," achi hi.
english: Say, ‘The king says, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.”’”

paite: Mikaiah in, "Galmuang a na hong pai nawnleh TOUPA'N kei zang a thu gen lou ahi ding," achi hi. Amah mah in, "Nou, mipite aw, na vek un na za un," achi hi.
english: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, Yahweh has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, all you people!”

paite: Huchi in Ramoth-gilead ah Israel kumpipa leh Jehoshaphat ahohtou uh.
heading: Ahab Sihna / (2 Kro 18.28-34)
english: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

paite: Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ka kibawl lamdang dia, kidouna ah ka hohtou dia; nang bel na kumpi puan silh in," achi hi. Huchi in Israel kumpipa akibawl lamdang a, kidouna ah ahohtou hi.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself and go into the battle, but you put on your robes.” The king of Israel disguised himself and went into the battle.

paite: Siria kumpipa'n akangtalai tung a heutu sawmthum-le-nihte kiang ah, "Israel kumpipa kia lou ngal mineu leng, milian leng akuamah sual kei un," chi in thu apia hi.
english: Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”

paite: Kangtalai tung a heutute'n Jehoshaphat amuh un, hichi ahong hi a, "Israel kumpipa ahi mah ve," achi uh. Huchi in sual tum in a-umta ua; Jehoshaphat akikoukhia hi.
english: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “Surely that is the king of Israel!” and they came over to fight against him. Jehoshaphat cried out.

paite: Kangtalai tung a heutute'n Israel kumpipa ana hi kei chih atheih un hichi ahong hi a, adelh lai uh anungkiksan uhi.
english: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

paite: Mi khat in tup tuam nei lou in athalpeu alai a, Israel kumpipa kithopna kikaltak ah akapkhata hi. Huchi in akangtalai hawlpa kiang ah, "Kaihei inla, sepaihte lak a pan hon pawtpih in, ka liam," achi hi.
english: A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. Therefore he said to the driver of his chariot, “Turn around, and carry me out of the battle, for I am severely wounded.”

paite: Huai ni in kidouna athupi mahmah a; kumpipa akangtalai tung a kingai in Siriate lam nga in a-opsuk a, nitaklam in asita a; aliamna a pan sisan kangtalai sung ah aluang hi.
english: The battle increased that day. The king was propped up in his chariot facing the Syrians, and died at evening. The blood ran out of the wound into the bottom of the chariot.

paite: Nitum kuan in sepaihte lak ah, "Michih amah khua ah, michih amah gam ah pai vek hen," chi in thu puankhiak ahi.
english: A cry went throughout the army about the going down of the sun, saying, “Every man to his city, and every man to his country!”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa asita a, Samaria khua alutpih ua; huchi in Samaria ah kumpipa avui uh.
english: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

paite: Samaria khua dil khat ah kangtalai asil ua; TOUPA thugen bang in uite'n asisan aliaksiang ua, agalvan leng asilsiang uh. Huai dil bel kizuakte kisilna dil ahi.
english: They washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood where the prostitutes washed themselves, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke.

paite: Huchi in Ahab tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, saiha inn alamte, akhosat tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he built, and all the cities that he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Huchi in apute kiang ah Ahab a-ihmuta a; asik in atapa Ahaziah ahong lalta hi.
english: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.

paite: Israel kumpipa Ahab lal akum lina ah, Judahte tung ah Asa tapa Jehoshaphat alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jehoshaphat
english: Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

paite: Jehoshaphat alal kipat in kum sawmthum-le-nga ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-nga vai ahawm hi. Anu min Azubah ahi a, amah Shilhi tanu ahi.
english: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

paite: Apa Asa lampi tot tengteng atawn a; pialsan het lou in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi. Himahleh mun sangte alamang kei a, mun sangte ah mite kithoih lai in gimlim ahal lailai uhi.
english: He walked in all the way of Asa his father. He didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes. However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.

paite: Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa toh kilemna abawl hi.
english: Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

paite: Huchi in Jehoshaphat tanchin dangte, athilhihtheihdan ahihlat thute, agaldou thute Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he showed, and how he fought, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Apa Asa dam lai a pasal kizuak omlaite, agam a pan adelhkhe vek hi.
english: The remnant of the sodomites, that remained in the days of his father Asa, he put away out of the land.

paite: Edom gam ah kumpipa a-om kei a, thuneihna piaksawn mi khat in vai ahawm hi.
english: There was no king in Edom. A deputy ruled.

paite: Jehoshaphat in Ophir a pai a dangka-eng po ding Tarshish longte abawl hi. Himahleh Ezion-geber mun ah longte asiat khit vek ziak in ahohta kei hi.
english: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they didn’t go, for the ships wrecked at Ezion Geber.

paite: Huchi in Ahab tapa Ahaziah in Jehoshaphat kiang ah, na sikhate toh longte ah ka sikhate kuankhawm le uh ake, achi a; himahleh Jehoshaphat in lem asa kei.
english: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “Let my servants go with your servants in the ships.” But Jehoshaphat would not.

paite: Huchi in apute kiang ah Jehoshaphat a-ihmuta a, apute lak ah apu David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Jehoram alalta hi.
english: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city. Jehoram his son reigned in his place.

paite: Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat lal akum sawm-le-sagih kum in Samaria ah, Israelte tung ah Ahab tapa Ahaziah alal pan a, Israelte tung ah kum nih alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Ahaziah
english: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned two years over Israel.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a, anu leh apa lampi totte, Nebat tapa Israelte thil hihkhialsakpa Jeroboam lampi totte atawn sam hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, in which he made Israel to sin.

paite: Apa hih teng hih in Baal nna sem in abia a, TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian ahehsak hi.
english: He served Baal and worshiped him, and provoked Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger in all the ways that his father had done so.
